title: Transport of split nodal completions with their scalar maps
statement: Let k,F,G be fields, A,B commutative local rings, α:k→A, β:k→B, ρ:k→F and σ:k→G ring maps. Let e_A:A≃B and e_F:F≃G be ring isomorphisms with e_A∘α=β and e_F∘ρ=σ. If the maximal-ideal completion of A [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is isomorphic to F[[u,v]]/(uv) [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] by e with e(α(a))=C(ρ(a)) after completing and quotienting, then the completion of B is isomorphic to G[[u,v]]/(uv) with the corresponding identity e′(β(a))=C(σ(a)). No Noetherianity is required.

proof.text: A ring equivalence between local rings identifies their maximal ideals since it preserves units. The completion-equivalence theorem gives the induced equivalence between their maximal-ideal completions and its equation on the canonical maps.

source.place: Tag 0E38, proof of lemma-closed-subscheme-nodal-curve, split-node specialization.

proof.text: Map power-series coefficients through e_F and its inverse. These maps are inverse ring maps, fix the variables, and carry (uv) to (uv); hence they descend to inverse quotient maps. Compose with the inverse completion equivalence and e. The two scalar-compatibility equations give the required equation.

theorem split_node_completion_transport
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    {F G : Type u} [Field F] [Field G]
    (α : k →+* A) (β : k →+* B) (ρ : k →+* F) (σ : k →+* G)
    (eA : A ≃+* B) (eF : F ≃+* G)
    (hA : ∀ a, eA (α a) = β a) (hF : ∀ a, eF (ρ a) = σ a)
    (e : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A ≃+*
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) F ⧸
        Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) F) * MvPowerSeries.X 1}))
    (he : ∀ a : k, e (AdicCompletion.of (maximalIdeal A) A (α a)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPowerSeries.C (ρ a))) :
    ∃ e' : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B ≃+*
        (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) G ⧸
          Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) G) * MvPowerSeries.X 1}),
      ∀ a : k, e' (AdicCompletion.of (maximalIdeal B) B (β a)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPowerSeries.C (σ a))
